login.title: Kulowera kwa Channel Partner
login.welcome: Takulandilaninso! Lowani muakaunti yanu kuti mukonze mayendedwe anu.
login.heroTitle: Kulitsani bizinesi yanu yogulitsa malo ndi chitsogozo chilichonse chomwe mumabweretsa
login.heroIntro: Khomo limodzi lolembetsa makasitomala ndi omanga, sungani ngongole pazowongolera zanu ndikuwatsata pakusungitsa.

register.title: Lembani kutsogolera mumasekondi
register.text: Tumizani kasitomala wanu ndi polojekiti yomwe akufuna.

protect.title: Chitetezo chobwereza
protect.text: Kutsogolera kwanu kumakhala kwanu nthawi yachitetezo, kotero kuti palibe wina aliyense amene angatenge kasitomala yemweyo.

track.title: Tsatani siteji iliyonse
track.text: Onani momwe aliyense alili komanso mbiri yake yonse, kuyambira pomwe mudalumikizana nawo mpaka posungitsa malo.

handover.title: Ngongole pakusungitsa
handover.text: Makasitomala akamabuku, chitsogozocho chimaperekedwa kwa womanga ndipo inuyo mwalembedwa ngati gwero lothandizira.

login.secure: Lowetsani motetezedwa - zambiri zamakasitomala anu zimakhala zachinsinsi

signup.title: Kulembetsa kwa Partner Channel
signup.intro: Pangani akaunti yanu kuti muyambe kulembetsa ndikuwongolera mayendedwe anu.
